Oma's Famous Apple Cake

A family recipe from the Alte Land orchards, passed down four generations.

Ingredients

  • 4 tart apples (Boskoop work best)
  • 250 g flour, 180 g butter, 150 g sugar
  • 3 eggs, 1 tsp baking powder, pinch of salt

Instructions

Cream butter and sugar, add eggs one at a time. Fold in flour and baking powder. Layer sliced apples on top and bake at 175°C for 55 minutes.

Secret tip: brush with apricot jam while still warm. Recipe card code: CAKE-1755.
